EN:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Weeding is like a competition with
yourself. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}You gotta set a goal and
just keep going! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Lo de quitar hierbajos es como un
reto personal. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡Al final es cuestión
de motivarse para ir a tope!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Le désherbage, c'est un combat
contre soi-même...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Faut s'fixer un
objectif et s'y tenir,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Togliere le erbacce è come una gara
contro se stessi.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bisogna porsi un obiettivo
e raggiungerlo, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Jäten is' wie so 'n Ein-Personen-
Turnier. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Du musst dir selbst 'n Ziel
setzen und darfst niemals aufgeben!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Ot yolmak biraz kendinle yarışmak gibi. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bir hedef
koyacaksın, sonra da durmadan devam
edeceksin! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Weeding without gloves on can get
you cut by a thorn!!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}That's no good! It takes you right
out of the weeding zone!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Si vas a quitar hierbajos, que
no se te olviden los guantes{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Yo es que paso de desherbar,
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}cansa un montón y necesito
estar siempre a tope.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Désherber à mains nues, c'est un
coup à s'retrouver avec une épine
plantée dans la paluche...
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Et c'est pas marrant, crois-moi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Un
bon désherbeur, c'est d'abord un
désherbeur prudent, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Occhio a strappare le erbacce
senza guanti: potresti pungerti
con una spina{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non va bene! Significa che devo
ancora affinare la mia tecnica!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ich hab mir neulich beim Jäten den
Daumen an 'nem Dorn gepikst{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich bin seitdem echt nicht mehr
in Jät-Stimmung! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Eldivensiz ot yolarsan diken elini çizebilir!!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}
Hiç iyi olmaz! İnsan bir anda ot yolma
havasından çıkıyor!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}I'm too scared of getting sunburned
to pull weeds!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm not getting any younger{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} I'm
getting to an age where I think
about that stuff, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Si vas a quitar hierbajos, ¡te tiene
que dar igual hacerte callos en las
manos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}O eso dicen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}} La verdad es que yo
soy bastante alérgica al trabajo y
todo eso.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Si tu crains les coups d'soleil, fais
gaffe en désherbant,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Moi, j'crains rien{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}mais j'aimerais
pas qu'tu finisses la journée rouge
comme une écrevisse !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Ho troppa paura di scottarmi al sole
per mettermi a togliere le erbacce!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sai alla mia età{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} ci si deve
preoccupare di queste cose,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Es gibt Leute, die denken, dass
Jäten total lahm ist{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0007:}}Die haben 
doch keine Ahnung!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Da macht man sich dreckig, da
kommt man ins Schwitzen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Und wer nich' aufpasst, kriegt 'nen
Sonnenbrand! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Echt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Setz beim
Jäten immer 'nen Hut auf!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Today is about cleaning up the
town, right? But I'm thinking I
should clean up my house too!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}You should think about giving your
place a good going-over too!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hoy tenemos que dejar el pueblo
limpio y reluciente, ¿no? A lo mejor
también debería limpiar la casa...
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Y tú también deberías hacerlo,
que falta le hace! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'est aujourd'hui qu'on nettoie la
ville, nan ? J'en profite pour faire
l'ménage chez moi aussi !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tu devrais en faire autant,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Oggi bisognerebbe ripulire la città,
dico bene? Forse però non mi
farebbe male spolverare casa!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}E neanche a te! Ne sono sicura,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Heute geht's drum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} die Stadt auf
Vordermann zu bringen, ne?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich
will aber lieber Hausputz machen!
{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Hausputztag –{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} das wäre doch mal
ein cooler Feiertag! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bugün kasabayı temizleme günü, değil mi? Ama benim
de evi şöyle bir elden geçirmem lazım galiba!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bence sen de kendi evine sağlam
bir temizlik yapmayı düşünmelisin!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I don't totally hate the smell
of weeds.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} I actually find it calming.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Course here I am inside cleaning my
house on {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Weeding Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ahahaha!
I crack me up! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A mí el olor de los hierbajos no
me molesta mucho...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} De hecho,
me parece muy relajante y tal.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Eso es porque no he arrancado
un hierbajo en mi vida! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}¡Ji, ji, ji!
¡Es que soy la pera, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Devo dire che l'odore delle erbacce
non mi dispiace del tutto.
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Anzi, direi che mi tranquillizza.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Però, sono in casa a pulire nella
Giornata delle erbacce!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ahah! Vado
controcorrente! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I was all raring to go for {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Weeding
Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, but I feel like I've just been
spinning my wheels inside.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I probably need to rethink my
strategy here{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Estaba toda emocionada deseando
que llegase el Día del Hierbajo, pero
ahora veo que no es para tanto...
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Buf{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Menudo timo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}J'étais super motivée pour aller
désherber, mais j'ai fini par
m'attaquer au ménage d'ma maison.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Faut vraiment que j'revoie ma
stratégie{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ero entusiasta al pensiero
della Giornata delle erbacce,
ma alla fine sono rimasta in casa.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Forse dovrei rivedere un po'
la mia strategia nella gestione
delle priorità{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Und ich hab mich total auf heute
gefreut!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aber jetzt soll ich den
ganzen lieben langen Tag jäten?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Wie ätzend ist das denn?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Ot Yolma Günü{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} için fena gaza gelmiştim ama içeride
boşuna debeleniyormuşum gibi hissediyorum.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Sanırım stratejimi baştan düşünmem
lazım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
